info.syllabusName: An toàn vệ sinh lao động (Occupational Health and Safety)
info.description:
This course provides theories and practical cases on occupational health and safety. 

  Chapter 1: Introduction to Occupational Health and Safety

  Chapter 2: 
Accident causation and investigation

  Chapter 3: Introduction to Industrial Hygiene

  Chapter 4: Ergonomics and safety management

  Chapter 5: Fire prevention and protection

  Chapter 6: System safety

  Chapter 7: Psychology and safety

  Chapter 8: Improving safety performance

  Chapter 9: Work place violence

  Chapter 10: Required written program

clos.loDetails: Study common safety and occupational health hazzards and measures to deal with them.
